fields.name: AppProtocol
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the EVCC for transmitting the list of supported protocols. Each protocol with a particular version supported by the EVCC is represented by one AppProtocol entry in the request message (maximum number of entries: 20).

fields.name: ProtocolNamespace
fields.type: simpleType: protocolNamespaceType refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the EVCC to uniquely identify the Namespace URI of a specific protocol supported by the EVCC, i.e. this is the protocol name of the related protocol.

fields.name: VersionNumberMajor
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the EVCC to indicate the major version number of the protocol indicated in the message element ProtocolNamespace. The protocol version will be incremented after every new release of the document.

fields.name: VersionNumberMinor
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the EVCC to indicate the minor version number of the protocol indicated in the message element ProtocolNamespace.

fields.name: SchemaID
fields.type: simpleType: idType refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the EVCC to indicate the SchemaID assigned by the EVCC to the protocol indicated in the message element ProtocolNamespace, VersionNumberMajor and VersionNumberMinor.

fields.name: Priority
fields.type: simpleType: priorityType refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the EVCC for indicating the protocol priority of a specific protocol allowing the SECC to select a protocol based on priorities. See also [V2G20-167].

fields.name: SchemaID
fields.type: simpleType:idTyperefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Optional:This message element is used by the SECC to reference one of the EVCC supported protocols received in the request message.Always mandatory, only not used in case ResponseCode is equal to FAILED_NoNegotiation

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType:responseCodeTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: This message element is used by the SECC for indicating whether the list of protocols received from the EVCC includes at least one protocol matching with the protocols supported by the SECC.

fields.name: EVCCID
fields.type: simpleType:identifierTyperefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Specifies the EVCC's unique identifier.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType: responseCodeType enumeration refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ResponseCode indicating the acknowledgment status of any of the V2G messages received by the SECC.

fields.name: AuthorizationServices
fields.type: simple Type: authorizationType enumeration refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: A parameter that indicates which Authorization Service the EVSE can provide.

fields.name: CertificateInstallationService
fields.semantics: If set to true, the EVSE provides the CertificateInstallation service.

fields.name: EIM_ASResAuthorizationMode
fields.semantics: Element to be sent when EIM is chosen as authorization method.

fields.name: PnC_ASResAuthorizationMode
fields.semantics: Includes the challenge by the SECC. This element contains the generated random number.

fields.name: SelectedAuthorizationService
fields.type: simple Type:authorizationTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: A parameter that indicates which Authorization Service, which was provided by the EVSE, is chosen by the EV.

fields.name: EIM_AReqAuthorizationMode
fields.semantics: Element to be sent when EIM is chosen as Authorization Method.

fields.name: PnC_AReqAuthorizationMode
fields.semantics: This element contains both the challenge sent by the SECC in AuthorizationSetupRes and the EVCC's contract certificate

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType:responseCodeTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ResponseCode indicating the acknowledgment status of any of the V2G messages received by the SECC.

fields.name: EVSEProcessing
fields.type: simpleType:processingTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Parameter indicating that the EVSE has finished the processing that was initiated after the AuthorizationReq or if the EVSE is still processing at the time, the response message was sent.

fields.name: SupportedServiceIDs
fields.semantics: Optional:A list that contains all ServiceIDs that the EV supports.This list can be used to filter the services that the EVSE will offer in the ServiceDiscoveryRes.When omitted, the EVCC intends to receive all provided services by SECC in ServiceDiscoveryRes message

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType:responseCodeTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ResponseCode indicating the acknowledgment status of any of the V2G messages received by the SECC in the ServiceDiscoveryRes message and for which additional information has been requested by the EVCC.

fields.name: ServiceID
fields.type: simpleType:serviceIDTypeunsignedShortrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: This element identifies a service which has been offered by the SECC in the ServiceDiscoveryRes message.

fields.name: ServiceParameterList
fields.semantics: Includes the list of parameters for a specific serviceID received from the SECC in the ServiceDiscoveryRes message and for which additional information has been requested by the EVCC.

fields.name: ServiceParameterList
fields.semantics: Includes the list of parameters for a specific serviceID received from the SECC in the ServiceDiscoveryRes message and for which additional information has been requested by the EVCC.

fields.name: SelectedEnergyTransferService
fields.semantics: Contains the selected charge or BPT service.

fields.name: SelectedVASList
fields.semantics: Optional:List contains all selected ServiceIDs and the ParameterSetIDs.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType:responseCodeTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ResponseCode indicating the acknowledgment status of any of the V2G messages received by the SECC.

fields.name: MaximumSupportingPoints
fields.type: simpleType:maxSupportingPointsScheduleTupleTyperefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Indicates the maximal number of entries in the sub-elements of a ScheduleTuple, where it applies to all elements of PowerScheduleType and PriceRuleType.The SECC can transmit up to the maximum number of entries defined in this parameter.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType: responseCodeType enumeration refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ResponseCode indicating the acknowledgment status of any of the V2G messages received by the SECC.

fields.name: EVSEProcessing
fields.type: simpleType: processingType enumeration refer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Parameter indicating that the EVSE has finished the processing that was initiated after the ScheduleExchangeReq. Alternatively, this parameter can indicate that the EVSE is still processing at the time that the response message was sent.

fields.name: GoToPause
fields.semantics: Optional: When GoToPause is set to TRUE, this indicates that the EVSE does not have any power available and the EVCC can therefore directly go to PowerDeliveryReq.

fields.name: Dynamic_SEResControlMode
fields.semantics: Includes price schedule for the session. Includes departure time in case EVSE provides it.

fields.name: Scheduled_SEResControlMode
fields.semantics: Includes several tuples of schedules from secondary actors. The SECC shall only omit the parameter "ScheduleList" in case EVSEProcessing is set to "Ongoing".

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.type: simpleType:responseCodeTypeenumerationrefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ResponseCode indicating the acknowledgment status of any of the V2G messages received by the SECC.

fields.name: EVSEStatus
fields.semantics: Optional:This element is used by the SECC for indicating the EVSE status and for signaling an event the SECC expects the EVCC to react to.

fields.name: OEMProvisioningCertChain
fields.semantics: An EV specific certificate chain, consisting of the OEM provisioning certificate and the OEM sub-CA certificates, that was earlier installed in the EVCC typically by an OEM. The ID of the OEM provisioning certificate (PCID), together with the information stored at the SA (contract partner), is used to identify the currently valid contracts of the EV.The certificates shall be DER encoded. Refer to ITU-T X 690 for details of DER encoding.NOTE 1 The OEM provisioning certificate itself (i.e. its public key) is used to encrypt the private key associated with the contract certificate in the CertificateInstallationRes later on.NOTE 2 The PCID can be given to the SA by the customer using a different communication channel. Please refer to H.1 and H.4 for further details.

fields.name: ListOfRootCertificateIDs
fields.semantics: This list contains the certificate IDs of all V2G root CA certificates currently installed in the

fields.name: CPSCertificateChain

fields.name: SignedInstallationData

fields.name: RemainingContractCertificateChains
fields.semantics: When larger than 0, additional contract certificate chains will be installed.

fields.name: ChargingSession
fields.type: simpleType:ChargingSessionTyperefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: ChargingSession indicates the intention of the EVCC to either carry out a ServiceRenegotiation("ServiceRenegotiation"), or to pause ("Pause") or terminate("Terminate") a V2G communication session.

fields.name: EVTerminationCode
fields.type: simpleType:nameTyperefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Optional:A string in URN notation which shall uniquely identify the reason for termination.

fields.name: EVTerminationExplanation
fields.type: simpleType:descriptionTyperefer to Annex A for the type definition
fields.semantics: Optional:Indicates the reason for EV termination.
